title: StageArtifact
description: Represents an artifact produced during a specific build stage in the workflow. Artifacts can include documents, diagrams, code, tests, configurations, and other deliverables.

id.description: Unique identifier for the artifact within the workflow

stage.description: The build stage during which this artifact was created

content.description: The actual content of the artifact. Structure varies based on type.

oneOf.description: Structured content (e.g., JSON objects for ADRs, SDDs)
String content (e.g., code snippets, documentation text)
Array content (e.g., list of test cases, configuration items)

encoding.description: Character encoding used for string content

metadata.description: Metadata about the artifact including creation details and relationships

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact was created

created_by.description: Agent or user that created the artifact

description.description: Detailed description of the artifact's purpose and content

dependencies.description: List of artifact IDs that this artifact depends on

size_bytes.description: Size of the content in bytes

quality_score.description: Quality score if artifact has been evaluated

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: backend-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: backend-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: backend
        image: registry.example.com/backend:v1.0.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: db-credentials
              key: url
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"

examples.content:
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from typing import List
from ..models import User
from ..services import UserService

router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["users"])

@router.get("/", response_model=List[User])
async def get_users(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):
    """Retrieve list of users with pagination."""
    service = UserService()
    users = service.get_users(skip=skip, limit=limit)
    return users

@router.get("/{user_id}", response_model=User)
async def get_user(user_id: str):
    """Retrieve a specific user by ID."""
    service = UserService()
    user = service.get_user(user_id)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")
    return user

@router.post("/", response_model=User, status_code=201)
async def create_user(user: User):
    """Create a new user."""
    service = UserService()
    return service.create_user(user)
